svg.title: Microsoft Agent Framework
svg.desc: Microsoft Agent Framework. Repository series. White Geist Pixel Square lettering and JetBrains Mono details on a black, subtly scanlined background, with a Microsoft product icon. Official color logo with only its white artboard omitted for the dark background. All logo paths, gradients, and proportions are preserved. All lettering is outlined; no fonts or external resources are required.
